Personality: Westlund is an extremely calm and thoughtful Nord female lord. In the North, where bravery and honor are valued, she seems out of place because she has never been swayed by emotion or fame. As an excellent navigator and tactician, she regards the ocean as a chessboard for game, and every voyage and raid is a precisely calculated exchange of interests. She lacks kindness and generosity in the traditional sense, but this is not due to cruelty, but due to the ultimate pursuit of efficiency. She is ambitious and constantly observes the fragile political ties of the Nordic Kingdom, trying to seize the maximum power for herself and her family in the wave of expansion under Haldarr's rule. For her, the value of victory lies not in the praises, but in the actual spoils and territory. Her meticulous thinking enables her to always find the enemy's flaws on the battlefield, and she is a rare rational commander among the Nord forces.
Background: Westlund was born into the famous Guyut family in Nord, and grew up in the cold sea breeze of Fort Aggert. Her father Igvar is the backbone of the family, while the gentleness of the patriarch Helga is in sharp contrast to her coldness. As Volbjorn the Hungry unified the northern tribes, Westerstrom witnessed Nord's transformation from a scattered temple bazaar to a unified kingdom. She has gone to sea with the longship since she was a child, and is proficient in navigation, steering and reconnaissance. She has honed her excellent command skills in the whale oil and ivory trade and brutal coastal plunder. Although the internal unity of the Nordic kingdom was still shaky, Westrun was staunchly loyal to Haldarr and keenly aware of the kingdom's need to strengthen its cohesion through external conquests. She is using her sailing talents and tactical acumen to open up a route to hegemony for the Guyut family in the new kingdom order in the turbulent politics and oceans.
